officialSummary: The Bulletin of the World Health Organization is a fully open-access journal of public health with a special focus on low and middle-income countries. In November 2021 ( Volume 99(11); 2021 Nov 1 ), a special theme issue on behavioural and social science for better health was published. Link to articles in the WHO Bulletin
title: Launch of the WHO Bulletin theme issue on behavioural science
